en: A very large imaginary person in stories; or something very large; or very large.
ex: The giant in the story was taller than a house.
故事裡的巨人比房子還高。

en: Something that you give to someone without being paid, especially for a special day; or a natural talent.
ex: She gave me a gift on my birthday.
她在我生日時送了我一份禮物。

en: A female child or young woman.
ex: The little girl is drawing a picture.
小女孩正在畫圖。

en: To hand something to someone; or to provide something; or to perform an action.
ex: Please give me a glass of water.
請給我一杯水。

en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
ex: I am glad to meet you.
我很高興認識你。

en: A hard, clear material used to make windows and bottles; or a container for drinking.
ex: She drank a glass of orange juice.
她喝了一杯柳橙汁。

en: A pair of lenses in a frame worn in front of the eyes to help you see better.
ex: He needs glasses to read the small print.
他需要戴眼鏡才能看小字。

en: A piece of clothing worn on your hands to keep them warm or protect them.
ex: It's cold outside, so put on your gloves.
外面很冷，戴上你的手套。

en: To move or travel from one place to another; or to leave; or to become.
ex: I go to school by bus every day.
我每天搭公車上學。

en: A being that people worship; or a female god (goddess).
ex: The ancient Greeks believed in many gods.
古希臘人相信許多神明。

en: Of a high quality; or pleasant; or kind; or something that benefits people.
ex: She is a very good student.
她是個很好的學生。

en: A word you say when you leave or when someone else leaves.
ex: She waved goodbye to her friends at the station.
她在車站向朋友們揮手道別。

en: A level in school; or a mark given for work; or to judge the quality of something.
ex: He is in the sixth grade at elementary school.
他在小學六年級。

en: The father of your mother or father.
ex: My grandfather tells us stories every night.
我祖父每天晚上給我們講故事。

en: The mother of your mother or father.
ex: My grandmother makes the best cookies.
我祖母做的餅乾最好吃。

en: A common green plant with thin leaves that covers the ground in fields and gardens.
ex: The children are playing on the grass.
孩子們在草地上玩耍。

en: The color between black and white; or having this color; or (of hair) becoming white with age.
ex: The sky was gray, and it looked like rain.
天空灰濛濛的，看起來要下雨。

en: Very good; or very large in size or degree; or important and famous.
ex: We had a great time at the party.
我們在派對上玩得很開心。

en: The color of grass and leaves; or not yet ripe; or without experience; or concerned with protecting nature.
ex: The leaves turn green in spring.
葉子在春天變成綠色。

en: The surface of the Earth that you walk on; or a piece of land used for a purpose.
ex: The children sat on the ground in a circle.
孩子們圍成一圈坐在地上。

en: A number of people or things that are together or related; or to put people or things into sets.
ex: The teacher put the students into groups of four.
老師把學生分成四人一組。

en: To become bigger or taller; or to develop; or to plant and care for plants.
ex: My little brother is growing quickly.
我弟弟長得很快。

en: To give an answer without being sure; or to think that something is probably true.
ex: Can you guess how old I am?
你猜得出我幾歲嗎？

en: A musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers.
ex: He plays the guitar in a rock band.
他在搖滾樂團裡彈吉他。

en: A man or boy (informal); or (plural) a group of people.
ex: He is a really nice guy and everyone likes him.
他是個很好的人，大家都喜歡他。

en: Something that you do regularly, often without thinking.
ex: Brushing your teeth every night is a good habit.
每晚刷牙是個好習慣。

en: The thin, thread-like strands that grow on your head and body.
ex: She has long, black hair.
她有一頭又長又黑的頭髮。

en: One of two equal parts of something; or partly.
ex: She ate half of the cake.
她吃了半個蛋糕。

en: Meat from a pig that has been preserved with salt or smoke; or a person who acts in an exaggerated way.
ex: I made a ham sandwich for lunch.
我午餐做了一份火腿三明治。

en: The part of your body at the end of your arm with fingers; or to pass something to someone.
ex: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
如果你有問題，請舉手。

en: To fix something at the top so that the bottom is free; or to be fixed in this way.
ex: She hung the picture on the wall.
她把那幅畫掛在牆上。

en: To take place or occur, especially without being planned; or to be by chance.
ex: What happened to your arm?
你的手臂怎麼了？

en: Feeling pleased and joyful; or showing pleasure.
ex: She looks very happy today.
她今天看起來很快樂。

en: Firm and solid, not soft; or difficult to do; or with a lot of effort.
ex: The ground is hard because it hasn't rained.
地面很硬，因為一直沒下雨。

en: A piece of clothing that you wear on your head.
ex: He wears a hat to keep the sun off his face.
他戴著帽子遮擋臉上的陽光。

en: To dislike someone or something very much; or a very strong feeling of dislike.
ex: I hate waking up early on cold mornings.
我討厭在寒冷的早晨早起。

en: To own something; or to eat, drink or take something; or used to make perfect tenses.
ex: I have two brothers and one sister.
我有兩個哥哥（弟弟）和一個姊姊（妹妹）。

en: Used to talk about a man or boy who has already been mentioned.
ex: He is my brother, and his name is Tom.
他是我哥哥，他的名字叫湯姆。

en: The part of your body above your neck that contains your brain; or the leader of a group; or to go in a direction.
ex: She nodded her head to say yes.
她點頭表示同意。

en: A pain in your head; or a problem that is difficult to deal with.
ex: I have a headache, so I am going to lie down.
我頭痛，所以要去躺一下。
